title: Publish release vignettes and run internal signoff sprints for customer changelogs
creator: Sofia Romero
description:
Objective: Produce a two-track changelog deliverable for the upcoming console release that includes short customer-facing vignettes (one-line impact + migration note), a technical appendix for eng/support, and an internal digest for GTM teams. We will run two rapid internal signoff sprints (engineering/docs/legal + GTM dry-run) to collect feedback and lock copy by the due date.

Scope:
- Executive one-paragraph summary for customer emails and product updates.
- 5-7 customer vignettes (feature-focused, benefit-first, with migration or breaking-change callouts).
- Technical appendix (API changes, SDK snippets, rate-limit notes) for Support and DevRel.
- Internal playbook: TL;DR, escalation contacts, known issues, rollback guidance.

Non-goals: full localization, automated changelog publishing pipeline (follow-up ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Customer one-paragraph summary finalized and approved by PM and Marketing
At least 5 customer vignettes edited and signed off by Product, Engineering, and Legal
Technical appendix validated by Eng leads and linked PRs/commits included
Internal playbook circulated to Support & AE teams and acknowledged in Slack
Release note artifacts uploaded to Drive + Confluence and a GitHub PR created for site copy
risks: Late engineering breaking-change details could invalidate a vignette and require rework
Legal review may require redaction of specific customer-impact language
Support docs must be published in time for AE prepping or customers may receive inconsistent guidance
